customers.evidence: That’s our commitment to helping you live your best life.

community.evidence: our purpose is to make the world a better place by bringing life-changing health technologies to the people who need them

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice ('our purpose', 'our commitment') centered on individual patients and personal living. Most stated commitments are broad purpose claims about health and the world; the headline is descriptive. Product examples are listed rather than framed as innovation. Legal disclaimers dominate the closing text, and no stakeholder beyond patients and society is addressed.
